description: Check an llms.txt against the format (H1 title, blockquote summary, H2 sections of `- [name](url): notes` links) and size. Pass `url` to check the file a site publishes, including whether its first 25 links answer; or pass `text` to check a file you have (a draft, a local copy), with `base` for where it lives and `links` to also test its links. Returns a short text report plus the REST checker’s full structuredContent, including counts, findings, line numbers and link checks.

base.description: With text: the site or llms.txt link it belongs to, e.g. "example.com". Resolves relative links.

links.description: With text: also check that its first 25 links answer (and llms-full.txt next to base). Default false.

text.description: The llms.txt itself (up to 2 MB), instead of url.

url.description: A site, a docs section, or the llms.txt itself, e.g. "llmstxt.org" or "docs.astro.build/llms.txt". Use url or text.

name: check_llms_txt

issues.description: Errors first, then warnings and notes, in line order.

code.description: Stable name of the check, e.g. `missing_title`, `broken_link`.

level.description: `error` breaks the format or a link; `warning` is worth fixing; `info` is a note.

line.description: Line in the file, when the issue has one.

status.description: HTTP status; 0 when it didn’t answer in time.

checked.description: Links fetched this run (the first 25); 0 when links weren’t checked.

llmsFull.description: Whether llms-full.txt is published next to it; null when not checked (a posted file without `base` or `links=true`).

anyOf.description: The file read as llms.txt (llmstxt.org): title, summary, details and H2 sections of `- [title](url): notes` links.

details.description: Markdown between the summary and the first H2, trimmed.

url.description: Resolved against `base` or the fetched file when possible, else as written.

optional.description: The section is named “Optional” (any case): links a reader can skip.

text.description: The section’s Markdown other than its links, trimmed.

summary.description: The blockquote under the title, without `> `.

parsed.description: The file’s structure; null when nothing was found (no file, or no title, summary or section in it).

site.description: The site’s origin; null for a posted file without `base`.

status.description: HTTP status of the llms.txt request; 200 for a posted file.

url.description: The llms.txt that was checked (or the last place looked when none was found); `base` for a posted file, null without it.

title: Check an llms.txt
